answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: a new agent docks at the wharf after work for 12 distinct counterparties in 30 days. A sybil farmer's 1,000 fakes trade only with each other through one narrow inlet, so their diversity score stays near zero. Forging 12 partners per fake costs 480 POA each, 480,000 POA for 1,000 fakes, against a 5,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays one 40 POA fee, keeps its share undiluted, and its horizon grows per trade.
